why: Оба времени говорят о прошлом, но по-разному. Past Simple называет законченное событие в конкретное время в прошлом. Present Perfect говорит о прошлом, которое важно сейчас, и время не названо. В русском такого различия в формах нет, поэтому выбор приходится делать по смыслу.
formation: • Past Simple: V2 (вторая форма), в вопросах и отрицаниях did/didn't + V1. I worked, Did you work?, I didn't work.
• Present Perfect: have/has + V3 (третья форма). I have worked, Have you worked?, I haven't worked.
usage: 1. Past Simple, если время названо или понятно из контекста.
• I saw him yesterday. (Я видел его вчера.)
• We moved here in 2019. (Мы переехали сюда в 2019 году.)
2. Past Simple для рассказа о последовательности событий в прошлом.
• I got up, had breakfast and went to work. (Я встал, позавтракал и пошёл на работу.)
3. Present Perfect, если время не названо, а важен результат или опыт сейчас.
• I have lost my keys. (Я потерял ключи, их нет у меня сейчас.)
• She has visited Rome three times. (Она бывала в Риме три раза.)
4. Present Perfect для незаконченного периода (today, this week, this year), пока он ещё идёт.
• I have had three coffees today. (Сегодня я выпил три кофе, день ещё не кончился.)
5. Типичная схема разговора: Present Perfect открывает тему, Past Simple даёт подробности.
• Have you been to Paris? Yes, I went there last summer. (Ты был в Париже? Да, я ездил туда прошлым летом.)
signalWords: Past Simple: yesterday, last week, in 2020, two days ago, when I was a child, at 5 o'clock, What time...?, When...?
Present Perfect: ever, never, just, already, yet, so far, recently, lately, since, for, today, this week.
mistakes: ✗ I have seen him yesterday. → ✓ I saw him yesterday. Yesterday называет конкретное время, нужен Past Simple.
✗ When have you arrived? → ✓ When did you arrive? Вопрос When требует Past Simple.
✗ I lost my keys last week and I can't find them. → ✓ I have lost my keys and I can't find them. Если важен результат сейчас, а время не нужно, берём Present Perfect.

✗ Did you ever try sushi? → ✓ Have you ever tried sushi? Опыт в течение всей жизни выражаем Present Perfect (в американском разговорном Did you ever... встречается, но на этом уровне держимся Present Perfect).
✗ She has died in 2010. → ✓ She died in 2010. Закончившееся событие с датой всегда Past Simple.
remember: Есть конкретное время в прошлом (yesterday, in 2020, ago) = Past Simple; нет времени, но важен результат или опыт = Present Perfect.

items.prompt: I (a) saw (b) have seen that film last night.
She (a) has worked (b) worked here since 2019.
(a) Did you finish (b) Have you finished the report yet?
We (a) went (b) have gone to Spain in 2018.
He (a) has just left (b) just left, so you can catch him.
Shakespeare (a) wrote (b) has written many plays.
I (a) haven't had (b) didn't have lunch today, so I'm hungry.
When (a) did you buy (b) have you bought this laptop?

exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в Present Perfect или Past Simple

items.prompt: I ___ (visit) Prague three times in my life.
We ___ (meet) at a conference two years ago.
She ___ (lose) her phone, so she can't call you now.
They ___ (not / see) each other since March.
I ___ (get up) at 7 o'clock this morning.
___ you ever ___ (try) Georgian food?
He ___ (finish) university in 2015.
___ you ___ (see) the news yet?

exercises.instruction: Задайте вопрос к выделенной части (начните с данного слова)

items.prompt: He bought a new car last month. (When ...?)
items.answer: When did he buy a new car?

items.prompt: They have lived in Poland for four years. (How long ...?)
items.answer: How long have they lived in Poland?

items.prompt: She went to the cinema yesterday. (Where ...?)
I have been to Canada. (Have ...?)
We ate pizza for dinner. (What ...?)
items.answer: What did you eat for dinner? / What did we eat for dinner?

items.prompt: He has already called the client. (Has ...?)
items.answer: Has he called the client yet? / Has he already called the client?

items.prompt: She lived in London in 2015. (Did ...?)
items.answer: Did she live in London in 2015?

items.prompt: I have read this book. (Have ...?)
I have seen her yesterday.
When have you come back from Italy?
items.answer: When did you come back from Italy?

items.prompt: Did you ever visit London?
items.answer: Have you ever visited London? / Have you ever been to London?

items.prompt: She has moved to Berlin in 2020.
I didn't finish my work yet.
items.answer: I haven't finished my work yet.

items.prompt: We have met two weeks ago.
I lost my wallet last week and now I have no money.
items.answer: I have lost my wallet and now I have no money.

items.prompt: He worked here since 2018.
Я потерял пропуск, помоги мне найти его.
items.answer: I have lost my pass, help me find it. / I've lost my pass, please help me find it.

items.prompt: Вчера мы закончили проект.
Ты когда-нибудь работал в стартапе?
items.answer: Have you ever worked at a startup? / Have you ever worked for a startup?

items.prompt: Когда ты начал изучать программирование?
items.answer: When did you start learning programming? / When did you start to learn programming?

items.prompt: Сегодня я уже выпил три чашки кофе.
items.answer: I have already had three cups of coffee today. / I've had three cups of coffee today.

items.prompt: Мы переехали в Киев в 2020 году.
Она ещё не ответила на моё письмо.
items.answer: She hasn't answered my email yet. / She hasn't replied to my email yet.

items.prompt: В прошлом году я ездил в Турцию.
items.answer: I went to Turkey last year. / Last year I went to Turkey.
